Function Scalar(v As Variant) As String
If IsNull(v) Then
Scalar="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
Scalar="Empty(0)"
ElseIf IsError(v) Then
Scalar="CVErr(10)"
Else
Scalar=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
End Function
Function ReadP(o As Object,k As String) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
ReadP=Scalar(CallByName(o,k,VbGet))
Exit Function
Failed:
ReadP="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function PutP(o As Object,k As String,v As Variant) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
CallByName o,k,VbLet,v
PutP="ok:" & ReadP(o,k)
Exit Function
Failed:
PutP="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function GroupIt(r As Range) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=r.Group
GroupIt=Scalar(v)
Exit Function
Failed:
GroupIt="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function UngroupIt(r As Range) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=r.Ungroup
UngroupIt=Scalar(v)
Exit Function
Failed:
UngroupIt="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function ClearIt(r As Range) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=r.ClearOutline
ClearIt=Scalar(v)
Exit Function
Failed:
ClearIt="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Levels(o As Outline,r As Variant,c As Variant) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=o.ShowLevels(r,c)
Levels=Scalar(v)
Exit Function
Failed:
Levels="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Observation() As String
Dim s As String,n As Long,o As Outline
Set o=ActiveSheet.Outline
s="sheet=" & ActiveSheet.Name & ";AS=" & ReadP(o,"AutomaticStyles") & ";SR=" & ReadP(o,"SummaryRow") & ";SC=" & ReadP(o,"SummaryColumn")
For n=1 To 12
s=s & ";r" & n & "=" & ReadP(Rows(n),"OutlineLevel") & "/" & ReadP(Rows(n),"Hidden") & "/" & ReadP(Rows(n),"ShowDetail")
Next
For n=1 To 10
s=s & ";c" & n & "=" & ReadP(Columns(n),"OutlineLevel") & "/" & ReadP(Columns(n),"Hidden") & "/" & ReadP(Columns(n),"ShowDetail")
Next
Observation=s & ";mixed=" & ReadP(Rows("3:8"),"OutlineLevel") & "/" & ReadP(Columns("C:H"),"OutlineLevel")
End Function
Function UGroup() As String
UGroup=GroupIt(Application.Caller.Parent.Rows("3:6"))
End Function
Function ULevels() As String
ULevels=Levels(Application.Caller.Parent.Outline,1,0)
End Function
Function USummary() As String
USummary=PutP(Application.Caller.Parent.Outline,"SummaryRow",xlAbove)
End Function
Function HiddenState() As String
Dim n As Long,s As String
For n=3 To 7
s=s & CStr(n) & ":" & ReadP(Rows(n),"Hidden") & ","
Next
HiddenState=s
End Function
Function VariantLevels(v As Variant) As String
Dim answer As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
answer=CallByName(ActiveSheet.Outline,"ShowLevels",VbMethod,v,0)
VariantLevels=Scalar(answer)
Exit Function
Failed:
VariantLevels="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim s As String,v As Variant,vals As Variant,o As Outline
On Error GoTo Failed
Set o=ActiveSheet.Outline
s="version=" & Application.Version & "|build=" & Application.Build
Rows("3:6").Group
Rows("4:5").Group
vals=Array(1.1,1.5,1.9,2.1,2.5,2.9,3.5,True,False,Empty,Null)
For Each v In vals
Rows(20).OutlineLevel=1
s=s & vbLf & "level(" & Scalar(v) & ")=" & PutP(Rows(20),"OutlineLevel",v) & ";read=" & ReadP(Rows(20),"OutlineLevel")
Next
Rows(20).OutlineLevel=1
For Each v In vals
o.ShowLevels 8,0
s=s & vbLf & "show(" & Scalar(v) & ")=" & VariantLevels(v) & ";hidden=" & HiddenState()
Next
vals=Array(-0.9,-0.5,-0.1,0.1,0.5,0.9,1.1,1.5,1.9,2.1,2.5,2.9,3.5,True,False,Empty,Null)
For Each v In vals
o.SummaryRow=xlBelow
s=s & vbLf & "summaryrow(" & Scalar(v) & ")=" & PutP(o,"SummaryRow",v) & ";read=" & ReadP(o,"SummaryRow")
Next
vals=Array(-4152.9,-4152.5,-4152.1,-4151.9,-4151.5,-4131.9,-4131.5,-4131.1,-4130.9,-4130.5,1.1,1.5,1.9,2.1,2.5,2.9,3.5,True,False,Empty,Null)
For Each v In vals
o.SummaryColumn=xlSummaryOnRight
s=s & vbLf & "summarycolumn(" & Scalar(v) & ")=" & PutP(o,"SummaryColumn",v) & ";read=" & ReadP(o,"SummaryColumn")
Next
Probe=s
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe=s & vbLf & "PROBE-ERROR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
